newsitem.title: USA: AES says will invest $98 mln in China plant.
newsitem.headline: AES says will invest $98 mln in China plant.

text.p: AES Corp said Wednesday it will invest $98 million of equity funding in the Yangcheng International Power Co, a $1.6 billion Chinese joint venture of which it will own 25 percent.
AES said it will oversee the management of construction and operations of Yangcheng's power plant.
The company said the joint venture was formed to build, own and operate a coal-fired power plant in the Shanxi Province in the People's Republic of China.

The project will be funded with $1.21 billion of debt and $393 million of equity. The debt will be provided by the China Construction Bank, China State Development Bank, US Export-Import Bank, and Kreditanstalt fur Wiederaufbau.
The joint venture will be owned by six partners.
The project is being constructed during a 60-month period under a fixed-price, fixed-schedule contract. The first unit will come on line within 35 months.
AES is a power company that owns or has an interest in sixty-five power facilities.
